01About ARCWORC

An independent
creative ecosystem.

Music, talent, experiences and ideas.
Connected through ARCWORC.

ARCWORC is the parent identity for a growing family of creative practices and brands. Our work connects artist representation, music programming, live experiences, creative production, digital work and education.

The agency helps artists reach the right stages and helps venues and promoters find the right talent. Our services bring music direction, brand identity, design and project thinking into a coordinated brief.

Through ARCWORC Presents, we develop distinct ways for people to gather: GUNGANO label showcases, invitation-only SOMA and the collective experience of PAMOJA. Each has its own purpose and atmosphere.

Our wider ecosystem includes GUNGANO Records, LYNNK Marketplace, LYNNK ENGINE, DOGON and the planned ARCWORC Academy. Their identities remain independent, with connections across music, culture, learning and creative technology.

From an idea to the audience

Artist representation connects career direction with practical booking support: availability, promoter communication, performance briefs, advancing and release planning. For venues and hospitality spaces, we shape music identities, resident programmes and carefully paced line-ups.

Our event work covers concept development, talent selection, production coordination, supplier communication and project management. Creative briefs can bring together brand strategy, visual identity, graphic design, websites and digital experiences, with a consistent story across every touchpoint.

Across the wider group, the label supports recorded music, DOGON connects stories with audiences through publication and PR, LYNNK Marketplace connects creators with commerce and collaboration, and LYNNK ENGINE develops tools for independent-label operations. The Academy adds practical pathways into music and creative work.

Based in Cape Town.

Rooted in African music and creative culture, with relationships that connect people across borders.

Built around the brief.

A booking, a venue, an event, a brand or a new venture. We connect the disciplines the work requires.
